campaign: Combined Deployable Proxy and Lab/Shadow/Analysis Build Campaign

overlaps.reason: Both source plans explicitly define the same fail-closed API-key and default-deny security change.

verificationProfiles.java-full: Focused and adjacent tests; clean package; verify and coverage; packaged smoke; diff/scope audit; current-head CI, CodeQL, dependency review, SBOM, Docker/runtime, and Trivy when applicable.
verificationProfiles.security-full: java-full plus startup fail-closed, authentication, authorization-role-matrix, actuator-exposure, and secret/default scans.
verificationProfiles.proxy-integration: java-full plus bounded loopback-only proxy fixtures for routing, retries, timeouts, streaming, lifecycle, and headers as applicable.
verificationProfiles.cross-process: java-full plus bounded local multi-JVM/process evidence with deterministic cleanup and no external target.
verificationProfiles.cloud-mocked: java-full using mocked cloud clients with liveMode=false; no credentials, network calls, tenant identifiers, or billable resources.
verificationProfiles.web-static: Focused documentation/static-resource guards, hostile-string rendering checks, browser/manual visual review when applicable, then the full repository verification ladder.
verificationProfiles.deletion-full: Compilation, focused replacement-contract tests, full test/package/verify, artifact-content audit, API golden-contract audit, and the normal remote gates.
verificationProfiles.deployment-local: java-full plus local self-signed/loopback or Compose evidence, Docker/runtime, SBOM, and Trivy; no public/external deployment.
verificationProfiles.benchmark-local: java-full plus bounded local benchmark/soak harness evidence; results remain local evidence and do not establish production throughput or latency.
verificationProfiles.design-first-growth: An ADR or bounded design contract first, then focused implementation tests and the applicable full verification profile; no live production target.
